description: OpenStreetMap : Mobilités maritimes - lignes is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. This dataset provides daily extraction of OpenStreetMap data flows relating to maritime transport infrastructures and routes in the territories of Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur, Occitanie, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, as well as the border regions in Italy: Liguria, Piedmont, Aosta Valley. Coverage: Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. The portal shows the English title as "OpenStreetMap: Maritime mobility - lines" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. Its keywords include route, circuit-de-navigation, itineraire-pour-embarcations, openstreetmap, voie-navigable, osm. The listing shows 1 download or service links in OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
